title: Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN) | All Shifts | Full-Time, Part-Time & Perdiem
description: We proudly offer a $4,000 sign-on bonus paid out over 6 months for new applicants (24 hours or more per week)! Join our dynamic team at St. Joseph Living Center in Windham as a Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN) and play a vital role in providing top-notch care to our residents. As an LPN, you will have the opportunity to showcase your nursing skills in a supportive and collaborative environment dedicated to excellence in healthcare. Whether you're seeking full-time, part-time, or per-diem opportunities, we have a place for you to thrive and grow in your career. With competitive pay ranging from $32-35 per hour plus differentials, this position offers a rewarding opportunity to make a real difference in the lives of our residents. Come be a part of our team and make a positive impact on those we care for every day. You will be provided great benefits such as Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Competitive Salary, Paid Time Off, Employee Discounts, $4,000 Sign on Bonus, shift differentials, retirement plans, and No On-Call rotation. WHO ARE WE? AN INTRODUCTION Saint Joseph Living Center (SJLC) was established in 1988 and is situated on 9 scenic acres in Windham, CT.
